title: Makerere Noonomy Conference Calls for New African Development Model
desc: KAMPALA — Makerere University has hosted the inaugural conference on the Theory of Noonomy, bringing together academics, policymakers and researchers to debate a new approach to economic development based on knowledge, technology, human potential and humanistic values. The conference sought to contextualise the theory, developed by Russian economist Professor Sergey D. Bodrunov, within Africa’s development […]

title: Mars Express orbiter captures detailed new video of the crater where Mark Watney was stranded in 'The Martian'
desc: Europe's Mars Express orbiter has captured stunning telemetry to create a new flyover visualization of the Red Planet's Southern Highlands and Schiaparelli Crater in magnificent detail.

desc: An international team of researchers has maintained brain organoids, three-dimensional models of human brain tissue, for longer than ever before.

title: Mpox: Children account for half of suspected cases in Guinea-Bissau
desc: Children, who are particularly vulnerable to the disease, account for half of the 46 suspected mpox cases identified in Guinea-Bissau – with 16 of them under the age of four.

title: Campaigners make final appeal to HSE over Skyclarys drug
desc: Campaigners advocating for those affected by Friedreich's Ataxia have again appealed to the HSE to approve the Skyclarys treatment ahead of a final decision next week.

title: New Study Finds Drug- and Diagnostic-Resistance Mutations Are Increasing in Ethiopia as Malaria Cases Surge
desc: Malaria parasites carrying genetic markers associated with resistance to frontline antimalarial medicines and commonly used diagnostic tests are becoming increasingly prevalent across Ethiopia.

title: Mission to stop an observatory from falling to Earth fails
